description: D-340 pressure fixture — the atomization-transparency caller. Declares a dependency on echo.ping range 1.x but CALLS echo.ping@3, a version no offeror in the composition answers. Dispatch must resolve by name + declared range to the compatible v1 generation — the caller never learns the exact version it asked for is gone (the seam that makes live upgrades and atomization additive). Undeclared callers keep v1 REFUSED semantics; only DECLARED dependencies earn the fallback.

capabilities.justification: Requests the (nonexistent) exact version it calls, while declaring the 1.x range — the permission is for the TOOL, resolution picks the generation.
